ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches occupying the distal and medial-lateral regions of both lobes, bifurcated by a central black pigmentation zone at the peduncle junction and extending toward the trailing edges. High-frequency black mottling observed along the perimeter transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 110 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with a notable increase in serration depth on the distal-lateral sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp upward convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of at least three distinct, circular high-contrast white rings (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) located within the central-right black pigmentation zone and scattered smaller white punctate marks on the distal white regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and minor indentations along the trailing edge suggestive of past tissue abrasion or predation attempts; unique black pigment intrusion pattern on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Rough, bulbous texture at the extreme lateral tips of the fluke lobes with concentrated dark pigmentation.
